agents.label: wave0-scaffold
agents.owns: frontend/ scaffold, frontend/package.json, frontend/.env.example, frontend/src/api/types.ts, frontend/src/api/guard.ts
agents.task: Scaffold the Vite React-TS app in frontend/ (npm toolchain). Configure VITE_OPENLENS_API_URL (dev default http://localhost:8000). Write TypeScript interfaces mirroring the contract in docs/workflow/tasks/frontend_plan.md (do not import backend code) plus a runtime guard validating the response/error envelope shape. No backend edits.
agents.done: npm run build clean; types.ts covers the full request, result, response, diagnostics, and error-envelope shapes.

agents.label: wave1a-search
agents.task: Build the search experience (frontend plan step 2): query input with non-blank/1000-char validation, mode selector (default, child-safe, news, shopping, travel), one filter toggle mapped into the filters dict, and an API client issuing POST {API_URL}/api/v1/search with limit/offset pagination against the pre-pagination total.
agents.done: Component tests green with mocked fetch: validation, mode/filter wiring, request shaping, pagination math.

agents.label: wave1b-results
agents.task: Build result presentation (steps 3-4): title link, snippet, final score, expandable reasons/warnings, applied_filters line, empty-result and error-envelope states, collapsible diagnostics drawer (fallback flag, per-provider latency, plugin executions, errors). Pure presentational components taking typed props; no fetch calls.
agents.done: Component tests green with fixture props: reasons/warnings expand, diagnostics render, empty and error states show.

integrate.label: wave2-integrate
integrate.owns: wiring and fixes anywhere under frontend/ (no new features, no src/ edits)
integrate.task: Wire the search form, client, and result components into the app; add the vitest fixture test parsing one real backend response envelope; run 'npm test' and 'npm run build' until green, fixing fallout. Smoke-test: with OPENLENS_SMOKE_URL set to a live backend, run one shopping-mode query and confirm results, applied filters, and diagnostics render; with the backend stopped, confirm the error envelope renders.
integrate.done: npm test green, build clean, smoke test observed, summary carries the frontend plan's validation checklist with pass/fail per item and the exact command evidencing each pass.
